name: smwgraphics-leprechaun-mario
title: Leprechaun Mario
description:
Mario dressed as a Leprechaun, perfect for St. Patrick's Day-themed hacks!

Includes cutscene, P-Balloon, running on wall and overworld frames as well! Though it doesn't include cape frames.

NOTE: The OW palette isn't a shared palette, and you have to insert it on all submaps.

Update: Fixed a few errors with some frames.
